item.title: Show HN: I created a new Deep Learning Framework
item.summary: I finally did it. I developed my own Deep Learning Framework from Scratch! I am calling it picodl. All written by hand, in pure Python, just using raw Numpy. Anyone can install it with pip: pip install picodl-nn I'd love to get feedback and your suggestions. Source Code: https://github.com/alight659/picodl Docs: https://picodl.vercel.app/docs.html Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49180252 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
